prompt: Locked-off static camera, the frame never moves. One continuous shot, no cuts. Cheap colour film, soft grain, warm pub lamps, teal rain on the windows. The woman in the burgundy cardigan holds the blank sheet steady overhead and talks into the microphone, lips and jaw moving naturally, eyebrows lifting as she asks. In the first seconds the man in the flat cap narrows his eyes, and the lad in the hi-vis vest tilts his head, thinking. Everyone else stays seated and still; glasses and papers stay where they are. The fruit machine lights blink softly. Thanks.
why: The quizmaster poses the tiebreaker; the regulars lean in to listen.
